anchors.basis: product as placed on market; dry sample, calculated as Al
anchors.product_scope: baked foods (bread, pastries, cakes, biscuits, cookies, crackers); deep-fried flour products; batter, breading, and frying powder
anchors.notes: GB 2760-2024 National Food Safety Standard for the Uses of Food Additives (in force 2025-02-08; supersedes GB 2760-2014). Finished-product aluminium residue limit 100 mg/kg (dry sample; as Al) governing the permitted aluminium additives (potassium/ammonium aluminium sulfate INS 522/523); China banned sodium aluminium phosphate INS 541 in 2014. Additive-agnostic total-aluminium residue cap. Corroborated by Codex GSFA CXS 192-1995 use-levels-as-Al for crackers (07.1.2) and ordinary bakery (07.1.3) both 100 mg/kg. Primary-verified 2026-08-10.

cells.scope_note: Concentrates span more than one route of use. The row is certified on the route-agnostic all-uses cannabis rules only (MA all-uses, Nevada, Israel), plus Maryland's inhalation total-chromium value as a route-protective disclosed read-across (a concentrate may be inhaled). A concentrate marketed exclusively for a single route must additionally satisfy that route's own row.

Ingested food-form route. Applicable pool = route-agnostic all-uses cannabis rules plus ingestion-specific rules (California non-inhalable, Colorado oral, MA ingestion-only, Maryland edible). Inhalation-route limits are not applied (see audit_excluded_ids).

Inhaled route. Applicable pool = route-agnostic all-uses cannabis rules plus inhalation-specific rules (California inhalable, Colorado inhaled/nasal, Maryland inhalation). Non-inhaled route limits are not applied.

Oral/sublingual route (not a food 'edible' form). Applicable pool = route-agnostic all-uses cannabis rules plus oral-route rules (California non-inhalable, Colorado oral, MA ingestion-only, Maryland oral). Inhalation-route limits are not applied (see audit_excluded_ids).

Cutaneous/dermal route. Applicable pool = route-agnostic all-uses cannabis rules plus dermal rules (California non-inhalable, Colorado topical/transdermal, Maryland cutaneous). Inhalation-route limits are not applied (see audit_excluded_ids); MA ingestion-only does not apply to a topical.

The filled cartridge / vape oil is a finished INHALED cannabis product, directly governed by the inhaled-route sovereign limits (same applicable pool as flower). This row sets total-CONTENT limits for the consumable. It does NOT cover metal RELEASE from the device heating element into the inhaled aerosol, which is a different measured quantity (emissions basis, ug emitted) and remains reserved — see reserved.cannabis-vape-hardware.
